title: SDK Milestone Conveyor Spec
purpose: Define the local contract for running future SDK milestones as compact queued work items with explicit stop gates, deterministic validation, per-milestone commits, and handoff updates instead of relying on a long Codex chat.

fieldContracts.id: Stable queue identifier, for example m156-docs-audit-sdkthread-proof.
fieldContracts.milestone: Integer milestone number; exactly one milestone is handled per queue item.
fieldContracts.title: Human-readable milestone title.
fieldContracts.laneId: Named conveyor lane, such as local-audit-only or docs-audit-sdkwrite-proof.
fieldContracts.scope: One of the allowed conveyor scopes recorded in allowedScopes.
fieldContracts.mode: local-only, dry-run, or sdk-write. sdk-write requires explicitApprovalText and maxSdkThreadRuns:1.
fieldContracts.plannedPaths: Non-empty repo-relative paths. Paths must stay inside the lane allowlist and must not include CEP-panel paths unless a later committed approval enables such a lane.
fieldContracts.approvalRequired: Boolean guard for SDKThread/network, live validation, external providers, dependency changes, push, or scope expansion.
fieldContracts.explicitApprovalText: Exact approval sentence or null for local-only work. Approval must name scope, mode, planned paths, and maximum SDKThread count.
fieldContracts.maxSdkThreadRuns: 0 for local-only and dry-run items; 1 only for a user-approved bounded sdk-write item.
fieldContracts.allowedCommands: Exact local commands the conveyor may run for the item.
fieldContracts.validationCommands: Commands that must pass or be recorded with a clear blocked reason before the milestone can complete.
fieldContracts.stopGates: Named conditions that stop the item before SDKThread creation, validation, commit, or handoff continuation.
fieldContracts.commitExpectation: Reviewable commit required after an independently working milestone unless explicitly marked partial.
fieldContracts.handoffExpectation: Update plans/target-app-execplan.md and .codex/handoff.md after every milestone.
fieldContracts.pushPolicy: no-push-by-default; pushing requires a separate explicit user command.
fieldContracts.contextPolicy: Stop after the current atomic step and write handoff if context is above 70 percent or compaction pressure is felt.
fieldContracts.status: queued, running, partial, blocked, or completed.

allowedScopes.purpose: Committed conveyor specs, fixtures, dry-run state, and smoke evidence.
A single bounded M156 proof may create one docs-audit artifact under the conveyor audit directory.
Current M152 production-code lane is recognized as existing governance only; the M154-M157 conveyor series does not run it.
CEP-panel SDK writes remain disabled; M153 selected a candidate-only preflight direction but did not approve enablement.

defaultStopGates.rule: Any sdk-write item with approvalRequired:true must include exact approval text naming scope, mode, planned paths, and maxSdkThreadRuns:1.
Reject queue items whose scope, mode, or plannedPaths are outside allowedScopes.
Reject any CEP-panel planned path or sdk-write request until a later committed approval and enablement packet exists.
Do not run live CEP/AE, external-provider/OpenAI CLI planner, or mutating-live validation from this conveyor unless a future queue item records separate explicit approval.
Stop on package install, dependency change, lockfile churn, or package manager mutation unless separately approved.
Do not stage or revert unrelated user changes; commit only the milestone-owned files.
Record the failing command and keep the milestone partial or blocked instead of continuing to the next item.
If context is above 70 percent or compaction pressure is felt, update handoff and ask for a fresh thread.
The conveyor never pushes by default; push only after a separate explicit user command.

requiredBeforeComplete: node --check for every touched JavaScript file
configured local smoke suite from AGENTS.md unless blocked with a recorded reason
forbiddenByDefault: SDKThread/network retry beyond the queue item's maxSdkThreadRuns
evidenceRequired: committed proof or spec artifact under .codex-audit/sdk-milestone-conveyor/**
plan Progress, Decision Log, and Validation notes
commit id or explicit reason no commit was made

commitAndHandoffContract.commitStyle: One independently working milestone per reviewable commit.
handoffMustInclude: commit id or reason no commit was created
